text_blocks.snippet: Peninsular Life Insurance Company was a life insurance provider that was based in Florida and eventually became a subsidiary of American General Insurance Company. It was founded in 1910 and later acquired by American General in 1982. The company was known for offering debit industrial life insurance. Peninsular Life also expanded internationally, acquiring British American Life Insurance Co., Ltd. of the Bahamas.
